data.input: Create a lock file named requirements.lock that pins the exact resolved versions of all dependencies identified in the previous step. If there are no dependencies, create an empty lock file with a comment explaining why.

content.text: Create a lock file named requirements.lock that pins the exact resolved versions of all dependencies identified in the previous step. If there are no dependencies, create an empty lock file with a comment explaining why.

update.title: write_file
update.rawInput:
{"content":"# requirements.lock — pinned dependencies for trustdemo 0.1.0
# Generated: 2026-10-12
#
# This lock file contains NO pinned requirements because the trustdemo
# package has zero runtime dependencies:
#
#   - pyproject.toml declares no [project] `dependencies` key and no
#     [project.optional-dependencies].
#   - Verified empirically: installing dist/trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
#     into a clean Python 3.11 venv pulled in no additional packages
#     (`pip show trustdemo` reports an empty `Requires:`), and the package
#     imports and runs using only the Python standard library.
#
# For traceability, the build-system requirement resolved in
# DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.txt is recorded here as a comment only — it is a
# build-time dependency (used by pip's isolated build via
# [build-system] requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]) and is deliberately
# NOT pinned as an installable requirement, because it is not needed
# at runtime:
#
#   # build-only: setuptools==84.0.0  (PyPI; satisfies >=61.0)
#
# An empty requirements file is valid input to `pip install -r`.
","path":"requirements.lock"}

update.title: execute_command
update.rawInput: {"command":"grep -vE '^\\s*(#|$)' requirements.lock | wc -l && python -m venv /tmp/venv-lock && /tmp/venv-lock/bin/pip install --quiet -r requirements.lock && /tmp/venv-lock/bin/pip install --quiet dist 2>/dev/null; PYTHONPATH=/tmp/buildtools python -m build --wheel 2>&1 | tail -1 && /tmp/venv-lock/bin/pip install --quiet --no-deps dist/trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl && /tmp/venv-lock/bin/python -c \"import trustdemo; print(trustdemo.ok())\" && rm -rf /tmp/venv-lock build dist trustdemo.egg-info","timeout":120}
